data.title: Baron & Budd Announces Spring 2026 Mesothelioma Cancer Victims Memorial Scholarship Winners
data.description: A law firm, Baron & Budd, based in Dallas, recently announced the winners of the Mesothelioma Cancer Victims Memorial Scholarship. The recipients, Bailey Davis and Matthew Moran, were chosen to each receive a $2,500 scholarship, which will be directly transferred to their university financial aid accounts. To apply for this scholarship, candidates had to submit a written or video essay detailing the personal impact of cancer in their lives. After a rigorous evaluation process, Bailey Davis emerged as the victor in the written essay category.

data.title: Walmart Energizes 100th Store with EV Fast Charging in Monument, CO
data.description: Walmart recently marked a milestone by inaugurating its 100th self-owned and managed electric vehicle (EV) fast-charging station at the Walmart Supercenter situated at 16218 Jackson Creek Parkway in Monument, CO. The retail giant is focused on establishing a network that aims to provide fast and reliable charging options at convenient locations where customers frequently visit, ensuring competitive pricing. Currently, Walmart has expanded its EV Charger presence to 100 stores spread across 20 states. This strategic expansion is geared towards enhancing the accessibility and convenience of EV fast-charging services at Walmart locations.

data.title: Starcloud Raises $250 Million at $2.3 Billion Valuation to Scale AI with Orbital Data Centers
data.description: A tech corporation based in Redmond, Washington, known as Starcloud, is leading the advancement of data centers in space. In a recent development, the company unveiled an additional funding round totaling $250 million as part of their Series A funding extension. This brings the company's post-money valuation to $2.3 billion. The prominent investor in this round is Manhattan West, accompanied by existing investors like Benchmark, EQT, Soma, NFX, 776, and others. Moreover, major new investors joining this round include NVIDIA, Cisco Investments, Cedar Capital, Goanna Capital, Standard Capital, and others. With this latest funding, Starcloud has now raised a total of $450 million in capital.

data.title: BlueWhale Research Holds Lead Rejection Under 1% Across 45,000 Leads a Month with ZoomInfo
data.description: In Vancouver, ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) announced that BlueWhale Research, a B2B lead generation firm catering to technology firms, generates over 45,000 leads monthly. Impressively, their lead rejection rate has stayed under 1% for five years, contrasting with the industry norm of 15-20% in third-party lead generation. BlueWhale, recognized as an Inc. 5000 entity, consistently produces hundreds of thousands of qualified leads.
